entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling to inquire about returning a helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Shield helmet, delivered about 78 days ago. To process this, could you tell me a bit about why you're returning it? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's more of a preference issue. The intended person didn't like the color, so the box is still unopened. We want to get the right one to ensure visibility and safety on their rides.
I understand completely. It's important that the helmet is just right. Let me quickly review our return policy for you.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Since the item was delivered within the last 10 days and it's in its original condition, we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid return label right now.

That's excellent news, thank you. Now, since I will be purchasing the correct helmet from VeloFit immediately, would it be possible to get a 15% discount code for that new order, just as a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience?

I'm glad we could approve the return for you. While I'm not able to provide a discount code in this situation, I can confirm that your full refund will be processed the moment the unopened box is scanned at our warehouse.
Alright, that's fair. I thought it was worth asking. I appreciate you processing the return so quickly.
Of course. The email with the shipping label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
